title: Autopilot profiles exist but Windows enrolment is blocked

messages.businessImpact: Provisioning will fail at the point a new starter first switches on their laptop, which is the most visible failure in the whole service.
remediation: Correct the platform restriction so corporate Windows enrolment is permitted.
Check the restriction's priority, since a lower priority policy can be overridden by a higher one.
messages.cannotSee: Only whether a Windows platform restriction blocks enrolment is read, not the order the restrictions apply in. A tenant whose blocking entry is overridden by a higher priority one for the groups that matter is reported here all the same, and the priority column is what tells them apart.
